name: cpu-prepared-backward-v1
mechanism: Select CPU pointwise backward operation/operand and Empty/Copy/Tree32/Tree256 kernels at plan construction; select CPU reduction-adjoint scaling/row kernels at construction; retain immutable checked geometry and original math/trees
guard_cases: all twelve cases of the immutable training protocol
primary: equal-weight geometric mean control/candidate complete-step wall latency across the four primary cases
block_order: control first iff (evaluation + catalogue_index + block) is even; otherwise candidate first
startup_order: control first iff (evaluation + catalogue_index) is even
case_order: rotate catalogue left by evaluation modulo twelve, then reverse for odd evaluations
windows: All original training windows, eight validation updates and six balanced paired blocks per case/context, unchanged frozen control worker

confirmation.experimental_unit: One fresh worker-pair context; paired blocks are aggregated within each case/context
confirmation.case_effect: Arithmetic mean of six paired log(control_wall_us/candidate_wall_us) per case/context
confirmation.primary_effect: arithmetic mean of the four primary case effects in each context
confirmation.interval: One-sided Student t lower bounds on mean log effects across exactly twelve fresh contexts, df=11
confirmation.per_bound_alpha: 0.05/13; one primary and twelve per-case lower bounds
confirmation.pass: primary lower bound >= log(1.1), every case lower bound >= -log(1.05), and all hard gates pass
confirmation.assumptions: approximately normal independent context log effects on this fixed pinned host; no population-wide or distribution-free confidence claim

hard_gates: all original independent FP64/eager trajectories, actual-update four-ULP checks and exact reset/repeat gates
bit-identical full control/candidate validation and warmed-window predictions, losses, gradients, parameters and sources
identical explicit resource and bound/fixture/seed byte metadata and zero warmed Rust allocations
unchanged local derivative formulas, ordered contraction trees, empty/NaN/signed-zero and error-before-write contracts
complete portable/Intel debug/release regressions, targeted signed-layout Miri and CUDA functional regressions

Fixed CPU UnaryBackward/BinaryBackward/ReduceBackward headers grow by at most one eight-byte function pointer each on the measured x86_64 ABI; record separately because dynamic resource reports explicitly exclude fixed headers
Supplemental long signed/aliased exceptional-value probe and baseline/candidate fixed-header probes pass before confirmation

diagnostics.artifacts: Read-only public entry/kernel symbols and prologues; at most one separate 8192-step wave-multichannel perf pair at 99 Hz if it can resolve an unexplained residual
diagnostics.scope: Diagnostic only; reserve sixty seconds conservatively for bounded premeasurement static commands; no partial confirmation statistic changes the fixed decision

stopping: One source candidate, zero timing screens or measured revisions. Freeze it after complete functional/bit/resource/header gates and before exactly twelve fresh confirmation contexts. Stop only for a hard gate failure, invalid context or budget; never replace a failed context, add samples or change thresholds after inspection. Restore scalar control on unresolved/rejected acceptance.
scope: CPU native-vs-native optimization on the twelve procedural cases; no fresh Torch timing, application or NVIDIA latency claim
precision_basis: Predeclare twelve independent contexts for the sole source candidate; no timing screen or selection between measured candidates. Prior tiny-case variability motivates replication at the context level, not reuse or extension of the completed families.
history_scope: A new prepared dispatch/strategy intervention; preserve both unpromoted row/isolation families and the original control. Family error control applies only to this one frozen candidate, not the unlimited project search.
